finding: The checkpoint/candidate/replay seam required for coupling already exists and is usable without changing F-KT or F-MR transaction semantics, but the currently scientific-admitted real-physics backend exposes only SWBOTB 7 or -2, which HeadCalc implements as free drainage. F-GC therefore cannot apply a predictor or corrector groundwater head boundary within the admitted profile.

kernel_candidate_seam.evidence: kernel_executor_t%advance_interval materializes kernel_candidate_state_t from a committed state or exact checkpoint without mutating committed state; commit_candidate and rollback_candidate are separate operations.

fmr_candidate_seam.evidence: fmr_trial_from_checkpoint, fmr_commit_candidate and fmr_discard_candidate are separate public operations.

fmr_physical_admission.evidence: execution_admitted accepts bottom_mode only when it equals 7 or -2.

fsi_legacy_binding_admission.evidence: validate_legacy_request fails closed unless swbotb equals 7 or -2.

evidence: SWBOTB 7 or -2 is explicitly the free drainage option.
SWBOTB 5 is explicitly the pressure-head-at-lower-boundary option.
For SWBOTB 5, the lower-boundary gradient uses state%hbot, which is populated from request%boundary%bottom_head by the explicit state binding.

why_fgc_cannot_work_around_it: Using SWBOTB 7 or -2 while varying forcing%bottom_head would not change the admitted free-drainage boundary and would create a false coupling test.
Directly enabling SWBOTB 5 inside F-GC would alter F-SI/F-MR physical admission outside F-GC ownership.
Reading or mutating HeadCalc internals from the coupler would violate the solver-interface ownership invariant.
Claiming H_SWAP = H_GW without an admitted controllable groundwater boundary would be scientifically misleading.

minimum_owner_capability_required.preferred_physical_seam: Qualified explicit lower pressure-head boundary through the existing soil_water_boundary_conditions_t / fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t bottom_head field, initially for the same restricted B1.10 physics profile and serialized execution.
minimum_owner_capability_required.candidate_legacy_route: SWBOTB 5, because existing HeadCalc already treats it as a specified lower-boundary pressure head and uses state%hbot in the lower gradient.
F-SI_work: Admit and qualify the explicit bottom-head request for the restricted real-physics route without exposing solver internals.
Prove the returned bottom flux is authoritative for the trial and mass accounting remains complete.
Preserve generic [t0,t1], candidate-only execution and same-checkpoint replay semantics.
F-MR_work: Promote the newly F-SI-qualified bottom-head capability into the exact restricted serialized physical profile.
Do not change transaction ownership or automatic production commit semantics; F-GC will continue to use the existing candidate-only checkpoint orchestrator.

minimum_reproduction.setup: Use the admitted F-MR05 B1.10 physical fixture and exact qualified source c28e7a2810b4a3678c577335a6a3086b173eb976.
steps: Run a physical trial with bottom_mode 7 or -2 while changing forcing%bottom_head.
Observe that the admitted HeadCalc route remains free drainage, so bottom_head is not the coupling control variable.
Attempting bottom_mode 5 fails closed at current F-SI/F-MR admission before it can be used as a qualified coupling trial.
minimum_reproduction.expected: No F-GC-owned predictor/corrector can impose an admitted groundwater head boundary; F-GC02 remains unqualified until the owner capability is qualified.

downstream_after_owner_fix: Predictor physical trial from T0 checkpoint with explicit groundwater head.
Corrector physical trial from the same T0 checkpoint.
Exact q_SWAP = -q_GW assignment and authoritative mass check.
Commit accepted corrector exactly once or discard without committed-state mutation.
Repeat for subdaily, non-midnight and multiple admitted coupling windows, then two-tile aggregation.
